Senior Growth Product Manager
Meesho
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India (Hybrid)

About Meesho:
Meesho is democratizing internet commerce for everyone in India.

The Role:
Own user activation, referral loops, and gamified shopping funnels for 100M+ Bharat consumers.

Candidate Requirements:
• 4-7 years experience driving growth product, A/B testing, and lifecycle marketing.
• Tier-1 institutes mandatory: strictly candidates from IITs or IIMs only.
• Exceptional fluency in SQL, funnel analysis, retention curves, and behavioral economics.
• High ownership and startup agility.
